<string name="info_m3_interp">Because R_ds(on)_25°C is a fixed constant in the model, R_mosfet_hot does not directly track MOSFET ageing. What it captures is the thermal variation around that fixed baseline.

Real MOSFET degradation (increased on-state resistance due to oxide wear, bond fatigue, etc.) will appear in R_eq_median rising over time — not in R_mosfet_hot alone.

The diagnostic signature of MOSFET failure is: R_eq_median trending up + temp_board_max increasing at comparable power conditions + SAG remaining relatively stable (cells still healthy). If SAG and R_batt also rise, the degradation is more widespread.</string>
